title: Remove fields of engram_build_checks.rs diagnostics that only tests read (dead-code warnings in non-test builds)
outcome: A non-test cargo check emits no dead-field warnings from src/engram_build_checks.rs. The diagnostic fields are either consumed by production or removed together with their test-only readers, and the meaningful diagnostic oracles stay in tests.
acceptance: Remove fields of engram_build_checks.rs diagnostics that only tests read (dead-code warnings in non-test builds) is done
